objects.original: Independent standard Gaussian coefficient tensors Xi_(i,p) in ordered Euclidean tensor spaces, collected into Xi in the Euclidean direct sum G_n.
objects.reconstructed: Euclidean block coordinate spaces on the C_b and a tagged union J of their coordinates, with the same array flat or grouped.
objects.evidence: Eq. (15) in the v1 PDF contracts against the p-fold tensor power of psi_i with the entrywise inner product. A slot (r,j,k) is the outer copy 0 <= r < p, the relative trailing level 0 <= j <= h-i representing level i+j, and the copy 0 <= k < K^j. A full coefficient coordinate chooses a basis index in Fin n for every slot. The dependent sigma index tags it with b=(i,p), preserving every ordered entry, including repeated equal basis choices; no symmetrization or quotient.

domains.original: Levels i=0,...,h and even degrees p=4,6,...,P; E_b=R^(n^(p S_i)) is entrywise Euclidean and G_n is their finite Euclidean direct sum.
domains.reconstructed: Fin (h+1) times the subtype of Fin (P+1) satisfying parity and 4 <= p; C_b is the set of all functions from the ordered slots to Fin n; the flat and block domains are real Euclidean arrays.
domains.evidence: Fin (P+1) includes P, even because 64(h+1)>0. Fin (h-i+1) includes 0 and h-i, and i <= h prevents truncated subtraction from altering the count. There are p times sum_j K^j slots and n^(p S_i) coordinates. Zero-based basis labels are a relabeling. The target family is a measurable product, not a claim about the default Pi norm.

quantifiers.original: The construction starts with a sufficiently large integer n and sets h=floor((log n)^(1/3)/32), then includes all specified levels and even degrees.
quantifiers.reconstructed: On the paper's parameter locus the same universal block ranges, obtained by specializing the positive n and natural h binders to the prescribed choices.
quantifiers.evidence: The comparison is on source instances: specialize n to the sufficiently large source integer and h to its prescribed floor to recover all paper instances. As an unrestricted sentence Lean is stronger in this slot: it quantifies n,h independently and works for h=0 and small positive n by finite coordinate reindexing and scalar products alone. This off-source extension is recorded as an explicit generalization, not equivalence of the unrestricted quantifiers.

assumptions.original: The source starts with independent standard Gaussian block draws at the construction parameters. No unit-direction or amplitude assumption is needed for this coefficient law.
assumptions.reconstructed: The input measure is the canonical standard Gaussian on the actual joint coordinate carrier; no assumed block law or independence.
assumptions.evidence: The independent source draws specify their product law. Collection is a measurable coordinate bijection and Lean starts from its flat output law; reversing it moves the starting measure without adding a hypothesis. The only Lean binders are n,h, followed by local definitions.

conclusion.original: Collection of independent blocks has law mu_n=N(0,I_G_n) on the joint Euclidean carrier.
conclusion.reconstructed: Grouping the joint standard Gaussian is a.e. measurable and its pushforward is the product of the block standard Gaussians.
conclusion.evidence: Collection and grouping are entrywise inverses, measurable by finite-coordinate evaluation and the Borel product structure. Pushing either identity along the inverse gives the other. The proof establishes actual measurability; the focused test derives all marginal laws and mutual independence, not merely zero covariance or pairwise independence.

scopes.original: The unconditional identity-covariance law in Section 4.1.1, not admissibility conditioning (Eq. (21), Section 6.5) or adaptive measurement conditioning (Section 3.2 Lemma 3.4).
scopes.reconstructed: Only the original Gaussian on the complete flat coefficient array, regrouped into its blocks.
scopes.evidence: Mathlib gaussianReal 0 1 uses variance 1, covarianceBilin_stdGaussian is the Euclidean inner product (identity operator), and integral_id_stdGaussian gives zero mean. The variance n*a_(i,p)^2 after Eq. (15) is for the scaled angular contraction, not the coefficients. No claim says conditioning on E_n preserves these unconditional Gaussian laws. The adaptive law instead has history-dependent projected mean and orthogonal-complement covariance.

constant_dependencies.original: K=2^(74(h+1)), P=2^(64(h+1)), S_i=sum_{j=0}^{h-i} K^j, and block size n^(p S_i); h is prescribed from n for the larger construction.
constant_dependencies.reconstructed: The same K, P, and ordered multiplicities; n gives the number of basis labels and h is a free natural parameter of the isolated law.
constant_dependencies.evidence: The degree bound in Lean uses 64 and the repeated-slot bound uses 74, with K^j copies per relative level j. The trailing sigma type encodes the S_i cardinality. Eq. (14) amplitudes, d_n, gates, query budgets, and tolerances are not inputs to this identity. The changed h(n) dependency is separately disclosed.

deltas.classification: ordered tensor and Euclidean coordinate elaboration
deltas.description: Explicit ordered slots, full basis-label assignments and sigma-tagging make the source carriers concrete without changing their domains.

deltas.classification: isolated law stronger in Lean off the paper parameter locus
deltas.description: The paper uses sufficiently large n and prescribes h(n). Lean independently quantifies n>0 and h>=0 for this finite unconditioned law only; it specializes to the construction.

deltas.classification: inverse measurable presentation of the same law
deltas.description: The source collects independent blocks. Lean groups the joint standard Gaussian by the inverse map; the pushforward identities are equivalent on common parameter instances.
HasLaw exposes a.e. measurability, proved here by full measurability. Covariance is the identity in the Euclidean arrays. Admissibility conditioning and adaptive posterior laws are outside scope.
